blocks.prompt: 8 The position vectors of the points \(A, B, C\) and \(D\) are \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = 7\underline{i} + 8\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = -\underline{i} + \underline{k}\) and \(\underline{z} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) respectively. Show that \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) is parallel to \(\overrightarrow{CD}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh "show that" (saabit karo) wala sawal hai. Do vectors parallel tab hote hain jab ek dusre ka scalar multiple ho, yani \(\overrightarrow{AB} = c\,\overrightarrow{CD}\) kisi number \(c\) ke liye.
Diya kya hai? Chaar points ke position vectors (origin se un points tak ke vectors).
Find kya karna hai? \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) aur \(\overrightarrow{CD}\), phir un ka taluq.
Plan: kisi bhi do points ke beech vector = (aakhri point ka position vector) minus (pehle point ka position vector). Phir dekhenge ke ek dusre ka multiple hai ya nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A\) ka position vector \(\underline{u}\), \(B\) ka \(\underline{v}\), \(C\) ka \(\underline{w}\), \(D\) ka \(\underline{z}\).
Saabit karna hai: \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) aur \(\overrightarrow{CD}\) parallel hain.
Tareeqa: \(\overrightarrow{PQ}\) = (\(Q\) ka position vector) minus (\(P\) ka position vector), yani "end minus start". Phir dikhana hai ke \(\overrightarrow{AB} = c\,\overrightarrow{CD}\).

\(\overrightarrow{AB}\) nikalein
\[\overrightarrow{AB} = \underline{v} - \underline{u}\]
\[= (7 - 1)\underline{i} + (8 - 2)\underline{j} + (4 - 1)\underline{k}\]
\[= 6\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) \(A\) se shuru ho kar \(B\) par khatam hota hai, is liye \(B\) ka position vector minus \(A\) ka. Socho: origin se \(B\) tak jana = origin se \(A\) tak jana + \(A\) se \(B\) tak jana.

\(\overrightarrow{CD}\) nikalein
\[\overrightarrow{CD} = \underline{z} - \underline{w}\]
\[= (1 - (-1))\underline{i} + (2 - 0)\underline{j} + (2 - 1)\underline{k}\]
\[= 2\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + \underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(D\) minus \(C\). \(\underline{w} = -\underline{i} + \underline{k}\) mein \(\underline{j}\) nahi, is liye us ka \(\underline{j}\) component 0 liya.
Dhyan dein: \(1 - (-1) = 2\) hai, 0 nahi.

Dono vectors ka muqabla
\[\overrightarrow{AB} = 6\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\]
\[= 3(2\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + \underline{k})\]
\[= 3\,\overrightarrow{CD}\]
Kyun: 6, 6 aur 3 mein 3 common hai; bahar nikalne ke baad bilkul \(\overrightarrow{CD}\) bacha. Yani \(\overrightarrow{AB} = 3\,\overrightarrow{CD}\). \(c = 3\) positive hai, is liye dono ek hi direction mein hain aur \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) teen guna lamba hai.

Tasdeeq (lambaiyan)
\[|\overrightarrow{AB}| = \sqrt{36 + 36 + 9} = 9\]
\[|\overrightarrow{CD}| = \sqrt{4 + 4 + 1} = 3\]
Kyun: Lambaiyon ka ratio \(9 : 3 = 3\) hai, jo \(c = 3\) se milta hai. Sab kuch theek hai.
blocks.final_answer:
Saabit ho gaya: \(\overrightarrow{AB} = 3\,\overrightarrow{CD}\), is liye \(\overrightarrow{AB}\) aur \(\overrightarrow{CD}\) parallel hain.
Dono same direction mein hain aur \(AB\) teen guna lamba hai.
